title: Asset Archive — Canonical Index Entry
description: One record in assets/indexes/global-index.json. Each asset from each run produces one entry. Upserted by asset_id.

asset_id.description: Primary key: {event_id}__{frame_id}. Used for upsert deduplication.

event_type.description: Semantic category of the event: investment_consulting, product_launch, seasonal_sale, etc.

template_family.description: Registry-backed template_id when known; otherwise legacy family name or unknown.

template_id.description: Validated template_id from core/templates when template inference succeeds.

template_inference_source.description: Where the archive handler inferred template identity from.

template_inference_warning.description: Reason template inference fell back or failed, if any.

intended_use.description: Role of this asset within its template: hook, benefit, how_to, cta, thumbnail, etc.

visual_keywords.description: Searchable visual descriptors derived from channel, frame name, and brand guide mood.

tags.description: Tagging-policy tags: channel:*, format:*, visual-role:*, objective:*, season:*, brand-tone:*, reuse:*

qa_status.description: Only pass items enter the reusable index.

reuse_score.description: Deterministic score: qa_pass(0.3) + channel_suitability(0.1) + template_stability(0.1) - event_specificity_penalty(0–0.3). >= 0.7 → reusable.

reuse_score_breakdown.description: Auditable breakdown so the score can be reproduced or replaced by a model later.

reuse_recommended_for.description: Channel IDs or event_types this asset is recommended for in future events.
